cases.prompt: Acquire four analog channels from one sampling reference at 2 MHz. Each channel presents 12 pF maximum load, edges must settle within 80 ns, and channel-to-channel timing error must remain below 5 ns.
Measure a grounded 0 to 2.5 V signal on circuitry powered from an independently isolated 5 V domain. Preserve 0.2 percent accuracy and prevent a single fault from bridging the two returns.
Deliver one 25 MHz logic clock to six receivers. Total receiver loading is 42 pF, output rise time must remain between 2 ns and 6 ns, and all receivers must start in a defined inactive state.
Exchange an eight-bit push-pull control word between 1.8 V and 3.3 V domains in either direction. Direction changes only while disabled, and neither side may be driven when its supply is absent.
Provide in-circuit firmware programming and debugging for a 3.3 V controller whose programming pins are shared with two application signals. Normal operation must not load those signals beyond 10 pF.
Run a controller and three peripherals from one 8 MHz timing source. The controller must remain programmable after assembly, and every timing input must meet its declared voltage and load limits.
Digitize a 0 to 20 mA industrial signal across a 1 kV functional isolation boundary. Maintain 12-bit effective resolution and enter a bounded safe output state after loss of either domain supply.
Connect a 1.8 V controller to a 3.3 V sensor bus and a 5 V interrupt source. Data is open-drain at 1 MHz, the interrupt is push-pull, and power-up order is not guaranteed.

Convert a 9 V to 30 V input into an isolated 5 V output supplying 400 mA. Limit startup overshoot to 5 percent, survive an output short, and keep the isolation boundary within reviewed working-voltage limits.
Produce 1.2 V at 2 A from a 5 V source with at least 85 percent efficiency. The load can step from 0.2 A to 1.8 A in 2 microseconds and the output must recover within 150 microseconds.
Read four open-drain environmental sensors at 400 kHz across 1.8 V and 3.3 V domains. The combined wiring and device capacitance is 310 pF and either domain may power up first.
Acquire a remote 3.3 V digital sensor over a 2 m cable at 10 MHz from a 1.8 V controller. Bound input current during supply loss and reject any solution that leaves signal direction undefined.
